description: A rendered thumbnail image. Holds a blob reference, never bytes — RFC 0002: artifacts are metadata in a lineage DAG, binaries live in the blob store. Adds the emphasised phrase so a later A/B can tell which framing was on screen. Additive optional field: a MINOR bump per RFC 0007.

text.description: The text actually burned in, copied from the brief so the artifact is self-describing.

background.description: What the renderer really used. 'gradient' means the stock background could not be fetched — recorded rather than hidden, because a gradient thumbnail is a materially worse thumbnail.

bytes.description: Payload size. YouTube rejects custom thumbnails over 2 MiB, so this is worth carrying.

emphasis.description: The phrase rendered large in the accent colour, copied from the brief.
